name: Gary Peters
committees: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
stance: Long-running focus on federal government use of AI — transparency, accountability and oversight of automated and augmented systems that interact with the public or make critical decisions.

statements.text: Sponsored S.5648, directing federal agencies to be transparent when using automated and augmented systems to interact with the public or make critical decisions.
